content: Good afternoon, this is Academic Advising. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I'm having trouble accessing some course materials on the student portal, and it's affecting my study schedule.
I understand how important those resources are for your success. I reassure you that I'm here to help you get this resolved as quickly as possible.
That's a relief to hear. I've tried several times but keep getting error messages.
Don't worry, sometimes these technical glitches happen, but you can trust me to guide you through the necessary steps to regain access.
Thanks, I appreciate that. What should I do next?
First, I'll verify your account status and then walk you through clearing your cache and resetting your portal credentials if needed. You can trust me to support you every step of the way.
Sounds good. I'm ready when you are.
